messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: Application Unexpectedly Exited
parts:
I just started seeing some odd behavior in my app and can't seem to track down the source of the issue.

I have an app located on a server in two different folder locations...one for the version under active development ("Dev")...and the other for the stable version used by downstream customers ("Prod").

I have copied the app contents (the entire Dev folder) from the development folder location over to the production server location and run the app both locally and through the web server interface. I get the following results (using Chrome):
  • Dev Version Of App + Run Locally - Works as expected
  • Prod Version Of App + Run Locally - Works as expected
  • Dev Version Of App + Run Via Web Server - Works as expected
  • Prod Version Of App + Run Via Web Server - Error

I have deleted the entire production folder multiple times and re-copied the entire contents of the Dev folder to the new location...with no change in results.


Any ideas?
